ev-packs.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged. Run /ev-activate and sign in with the same account as before, so your pack credits and reports are there.

ev-packs.not-signed-in.say: This machine is not set up for Evalation yet. Run /ev-start to set it up.

ev-packs.unreachable.say: Evalation could not be reached. Check this machine is online and run /ev-packs again.

ev-packs.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong, so Evalation refused it. Set the clock to the right time, then run /ev-packs again.

ev-packs.refused.say: Evalation no longer accepts this machine. Contact support@evalation.ai and we will sort it out.

ev-packs.ended.say: This machine's access to Evalation has ended. To renew it, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-packs.other.say: Evalation could not confirm this machine just now. Run /ev-packs again in a few minutes. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-packs.contact-support.say: Contact support@evalation.ai to sort out your account.

ev-packs.what-a-pack.say: A pack is one thing your code is checked against, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, a security hardening review, or a review for a cyber insurer or investor. You can pick several.

ev-packs.gone-pack.say: a pack Evalation no longer offers

options.label: Keep these packs
options.description: Your checks keep using these packs.

options.label: Choose packs again
options.description: Pick from every pack Evalation offers.

ev-packs.kept.say: Your checks still use <titles>, <count> pack credits each time.

ev-packs.kept-one.say: Your checks still use <titles>, one pack credit each time.

ev-packs.not-enough.say: A check will not start until you have more. To buy more pack credits, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-packs.cost.say: Each pack you choose uses one pack credit every time your code is checked.

ev-packs.which.ask: Which packs should each check of your code use?

none.label: None of these
none.description: Uses none of the packs in this list.

ev-packs.nothing-changed.say: Nothing changed. Your checks still use <titles>.

ev-packs.nothing-chosen.say: Nothing changed. No packs are chosen yet.

ev-packs.short.say: These packs use <count> pack credits every time your code is checked, and you have <credits>, so a check will not start. To buy more pack credits, email support@evalation.ai.

options.label: Save these packs

options.label: Choose packs again
options.description: Pick from every pack Evalation offers.

ev-packs.saved.say: From now on your checks use <titles>, <count> pack credits each time. You can change this with /ev-packs.

ev-packs.saved-one.say: From now on your checks use <titles>, one pack credit each time. You can change this with /ev-packs.

ev-packs.next.say: Next, run /ev-run to check a repository against these packs. It also lets you pick other packs for that check alone.
